problem: Low awareness of Catalyst among entrepreneurs outside our community, and thus a lot of untapped potential for Cardano development
solution: Online Marketing Campaign as a fast and efficient way to attract entrepreneurs to increase diversity and quality of proposals in Catalyst
title: 60-Day Online Marketing Campaign

problem: The marketplace remains fragmented, however, with liquidity still lacking on individual DEXes compared to their CEX counterparts.
solution: DEX aggregators have emerged to pool that fragmented liquidity together into a single platform like Instamo to solve the problem.
title: A DEX aggregator built on Cardano

problem: There is a shortage of DEXs, Dapps building on Cardano's Ecosystems
solution: Instamo - A cross-chain DEX aggregator attracts other startups and businesses building the other DEXs on Cardano to grow global communities
title: A DEX aggregator on Cardano

problem: For those in Ethiopia without access to traditional exchanges, purchasing ADA is prohibitively difficult and expensive.
solution: Provide free exchange of Ethiopian Birr for ADA via in person and mobile transactions.
title: ADA Liquidity for Ethiopia

problem: Many people have great ideas they want to build on Cardano, but they lack DEV capabilities to get from an Idea to a MVP they can test out.
solution: ADA MakerSpace will take a cohort of entrepreneurs through a 16 week Accelerator Program in which we will build their Minimal Viable Product
title: ADA MakerSpace Accelerator

problem: News about Cardano should be available in native languages in African communities. However, The crypto world is English-speaking oriented
solution: Create a chain of YouTube channels bringing docutainment and a weekly edited news broadcast in native languages
title: ADA news in African languages

problem: Existing freelancer marketplaces struggle with high fees and low payments as well as delivering consistent quality of work
solution: Create a decentralized freelancer marketplace using Cardano blockchain that offers instance payment, low fees and fair dispute settlement
title: ADALancer

problem: Traditional payment between companies are opaque, human-based and complex to audit. Debtors can delay payment or not respect commercial term
solution: E-invoice as transaction metadata and smart contract managing inter-exchange between companies (self-invoicing, periodic invoices,...)
title: ADAvoice: Decentralized E-invoicing

problem: APY's of financial products in Africa has dropped from 20% to 2% APY in the past 5 years due to deflation, political corruption and covid-19
solution: We propose to build the first ever MTN/Mobile Money Bridge to DeFi in Nigeria/Kenya using Mobile Merchant On-ramps and lending protocols.
title: ADD.xyz's DeFi Mobile Money Bridge

problem: Drug & medical funding is heavily centralised. Africa lacks investment & solutions despite native scientific talent.
solution: De-Fi platform leveraging stake pools to crowdfund open-source drug/medical projects, where scientific collaboration & governance is central
title: Africa Opensource Pharma & Medicine

problem: Africa has a high number of university graduates each year but lacks a pathway for those graduates to enter employment or start a business.
solution: Secure Foothold will deploy an African launchpad on the Cardano blockchain, the launchpad will kickstart a business idea for Africans
title: African launchpad

problem: There aren't many resources available for the East and Central African Regions
solution: Maasai.io will be the foremost resource tailored to E. & C. African regional needs through relevant and current content and an ADA market.
title: Africa's Cardano Resource

problem: There's a gap between Catalyst and a fast-growing Spanish Community, eager to participate and learn to do so in their native language.
solution: ALDEA Catalyst is a site for people to find information in Spanish about Catalyst and develop hot valuable skills for the ecosystem.
title: ALDEA Catalyst Spanish Support Site

problem: $200B betting industry lacks trust.
solution: Create a decentralized social betting platform connecting people via social media & letting them set their own odds, eliminating the house.
title: ALLIN Social Betting Platform

problem: Financing innovation, science, and culture need complex economic protocols but developing these financial primitives is difficult.
solution: A reusable module (money legos) of economic protocols based on bonding curves to scale up continuous project financing and investment.
title: AMM for Continuous Financing

problem: Animals in Africa and other countries are being killed to extinction by poachers, climate change and deforestation.
solution: Develop a Staking Rewards Distribution System via a Smart Contract to support these Organizations and the Supporters with NFTs
title: Animal Conservation - NFT Rewards

problem: Ebooks market is highly centralized, censored, and dominated by Amazon Kindle. There is a general lack of marketplaces in the crypto world
solution: Aregato - ebook marketplace with blogging and social media features, built on top of Cardano, with Cardano native assets and NFTs
title: Aregato - ADA ebook marketplace

problem: Mobile devs who want to integrate Cardano, have to build their own replica of tools, which requires knowledge of cryptography.
solution: Create a software development kit (SDK) in Swift. Lay a foundation for building mobile Cardano apps without knowing cryptographic internals.
title: Arnot - iOS SDK

problem: Many NFT marketplaces do not put users first: they have high commission fees, they are hard to navigate, heavily curated and centralized
solution: An NFT marketplace that is user-driven, open to all and fraud-resistant. We want to build a community, not just a product!
title: Artano - The NFT Art Marketplace

problem: Apps for training AI & ML algorithms tend to be centralized, with no transparency. This can bring biased results as the algorithm learn
solution: The immutable ledger and transparency of the public blockchain will provide the decentralised, trusted solution AI and ML desperately needs.
title: Artificial Intelligence/ML API

problem: DeFi smart contracts that anyone can interact with are subject to "DoS" attacks by constantly racing other participants to the current UTXO.
solution: We solve issue by offering an "Account" view on top of the UTXO model of Cardano, using malleable transactions and Node-Extractable Value.
title: AVOUM: Account View on UTXO Model

problem: Tax compliance obligations under US tax policy are difficult to track correctly, especially when on chain transactions are involved.
solution: Develop a web based tax solution that can easily manage both the on chain activity of Cardano, as well as the staking reward activity.
title: Back to Basis - Tax compliance tool

problem: 272M migrants around the world sending their hard earn 1.76T USD back home through underground remittance.
solution: To develop a stable-coin remittance system that provides a smooth user experience, utilizing Blockchain to give financial access to anyone.
title: Banking The Unbanked

problem: People find it intimidating to start participating in Project Catalyst.
solution: Weekly workshops for "Catalyst Skeptics" in which newcomers identify barriers to entry that can be reframed as the seeds of new Proposals.
title: Barriers to Entry = Proposals

problem: Cardano's software is written in Haskell. This represents a great learning curve for many developers who use other more popular languages
solution: Developing bindings for other languages that do not force developers to move from the comfort of their usual development environments.
title: Bind to other Prog.Languages

problem: NFTs are not being used to their fullest potential-- As a means to represent tangible real-world assets in the blockchain.
solution: Bitbuny.io will offer a fun proof-of-concept way to experiment with new representation of blockchain assets with the goal of adding value.
title: BitBunny.io: Adopt animals w/ NFT

problem: In order to ensure true decentralisation to services and dApps, a blockchain friendly authentication mechanism should be ideated.
solution: Implement a decentralised authentication mechanism that will persist on chain, secrets and permissions based on metadata and native assets.

problem: NFTs are confusing. There's a need for an intuitive Dapp that can bridge the gap between mass adoption, utility, and most importantly, fun.
solution: Team Burblr is connecting humans to Cardano by allowing them to collect and trade NFT audio/eBooks in a gamified way, with a credit card.
title: Burblr - let's make books fun.

problem: Sensitive document verification should be simple, but in 2020 alone companies lost 1.8 Billion dollars in the US as a result of BEC attacks.
solution: An email plug-in that allows professional users to certify and verify sensitive messages, from the comfort of their own email application.
title: Business Email Compromise solution

problem: C# developers are missing (and asked for) tools to enjoy Blockfrost.io, a service that provides free and public Cardano API to developers.
solution: We want to build an open-source SDK (Software Development Kit - a set of tools, libraries and documentation) for C# developers.

problem: Minting signed assets fully on-chain , allowing creators to distribute authenticated and verifiable content with long-term availability.
solution: Development of a light wallet that provides sovereignty to mint and sign non-fungible tokens (NFTs) 100% on-chain from digital assets .

problem: Trees are being cut down at a rapid pace, forests are disappearing, co2 is increasing, the ecosystems that clean our air are in major danger
solution: Carbonland Trust's DEX to trade carbon credit NFTs based on actual Forest being conserved will inspire & fund conservation efforts all over
title: Carbonland Trust Carbon Credits DEX

problem: There is a lack of casual apps/games built on Cardano which will be key in order to attract less technical crowds to the project.
solution: A trading card game where each card represents a city. Players can buy and sell cards with ADA. Dynamic events to make the market move.
title: Cardacity: a trading card game

problem: Catalyst is growing, we have Fund winners who need to hire implementers, and we have definitely a need for jobs & services place
solution: By creating Cardano jobs & services site we encourage more meaningful participation in Project Catalyst from ADA community and beyond
title: Cardano Catalyst Jobs & Services

problem: Entrepreneurs are looking for fundraising and are not aware about Cardano & Catalyst.
solution: A curated newsletter increases awareness, builds trust and drives entrepreneurs to Project Catalyst and the Cardano ecosystem.

problem: DeFi DApps require a web wallet to interact with (like Metamask)
solution: A Chrome extension connector (similar to Metamask) that will enable communication between wallets and DApps.

problem: IPFS is widely used in the Cardano ecosystem. Data stored on IPFS is prone to disappear if not used and will be lost forever.
solution: We have built a community service where we archive all IPFS data that appears on the Cardano blockchain for future generations.

problem: At this point, only an in-depth study of how Cardano works allows you to make the simplest Javascript web application.
solution: Develop library on top of cardano-graphql and cardano-serilazation-lib, with transparent methods to work with Cardano cryptography & data.

problem: Blockchain solutions for IBO's are extremely hard to find and understand.
solution: "Cardano Marketplace is building a freelance exchange by connecting IBO's & DEF's across Cardano as a Multi-Vendor Marketplace."

problem: A Vast majority of the Ethiopian youth have never even heard of cardano and there is no active and engaged community.
solution: A cardano students club and ambassadorship program will enable students to learn from each other and increase engagement in the community.

problem: Wow this is overwhelming! Where do start? How do I find collaborators? Navigate platform? What ideas are already presented? How am I doing?

problem: There is a need to encourage entrepreneurs from outside the Cardano ecosystem to submit proposals to Catalyst

problem: 2 "Ready to mass produce" Devices
solution: App integration of Daedalus to memory core. Important to improve app experience. Ubuntu $45,000 for dev and updates, Fedora Workstation OS

Understand SPO diversity/representation
Staking decision prototype
Work with communities and SPO information services to drive African SPO

problem:
Content Platforms (Netflix) are making Billions as the profit as the middleman.
Unfair rewarding for creators
High fees for end users
